headline: A-One Steels India reports violation under SEBI Insider Trading regulations
hook: Insider trading code violation reported by A-One Steels
summary: A-One Steels India Limited has formally reported a violation of the Code of Conduct under SEBI's Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015, to the stock exchange. The filing highlights compliance issues regarding trading norms within the company. Regulatory disclosures of this nature are mandatory under SEBI guidelines for listed entities. Indian retail investors tracking corporate governance should note compliance lapses in micro-cap steel firms.
whats_next: SEBI review or further company disclosures
why_it_matters: Governance lapses flag risks for small-cap equity holders
